CustomField.description: Fundraising Quick Start: when TRUE, gifts and commitments on this campaign automatically create or advance a CampaignMember row for the donor. Only meaningful for Tactical-level campaigns (FQS_Hierarchy_Depth__c >= 3) — the record page hides this field on Strategic (depth 1) and Operational (depth 2) campaigns via flexipage visibility rules, and the FQS_Campaign_Auto_Members_Default before-save flow sets it to TRUE on insert only when depth >= 3. Flows gated by this field: FQS_Campaign_Member_Status_On_Gift, FQS_Campaign_Member_Status_On_Commitment, and their delete/downgrade companions.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: When checked, gifts and commitments on this campaign automatically create or advance a Campaign Member row for the donor. Only applies to Tactical-level campaigns (Hierarchy Depth >= 3). Uncheck to opt this campaign out of automatic member tracking.
CustomField.label: Enable Automatic Campaign Members
